folded.id: agama|na|atteppereng
folded.subject: agama

spans.text: Sininna rupa tau nappunnai maneng riasengnge hak na kebebasang ye tarukie ri lalenna Ada Assamaturusengnge, na degaga riasengnge mappasilaingeng appongeng, mappasilaingeng warenna uli, mappasilaingeng urane na makkunrai, mappasilaingeng bangsa, bahasa, agama na atteppereng, politik, arega mappasilaingeng assaleng ussulu bangsana , assugirenna, onro jajianna arega pangka'na.

Sininna rupa tau nappunai hak riasengnge kebebasang ri laleng mappikkiri, pattennang atinna na agamana, arega lecce agama na atteppereng, na kebebasang panessai agama na atteprenna arega napagguruangngi na nalalengi.

spans.text: Nappunai riasengnge akkaleng, nappunai riasengnge ati marennni na sibole bolena pada sipakatau pada massalasureng.

folded.subject: elonapi

spans.text: Degaga riaseng passang rilalenna perkawinangnge, pappilenapi, elonapi na situjuipi makkunraie na urane.

spans.text: Sininna rupa tau nappunnai maneng riasengnge hak na kebebasang ye tarukie ri lalenna Ada Assamaturusengnge, na degaga riasengnge mappasilaingeng appongeng, mappasilaingeng warenna uli, mappasilaingeng urane na makkunrai, mappasilaingeng bangsa, bahasa, agama na atteppereng, politik, arega mappasilaingeng assaleng ussulu bangsana , assugirenna, onro jajianna arega pangka'na.

spans.text: Pura ritimbang nasengnge dipattongengngi ri asengnge allebbireng napanjajie puang seuwae na hak-hak pada nappunnai manengnge salasureng padatta rupa tau ianaro simulangenna riasengnge merdeka e .

spans.text: Sininna rupa tau nappunai hak monro ri sininna negarae', makkotoro ko maeloi monro ri negarana arega maelo lisu ri negarana.

folded.subject: riasengnge assugireng

spans.text: Sininna rupa tauwe nappunai hak riasengnge assugireng na warangparang, mo nappunnangi seddi tau arega nappunnangi sibawa tau laingnge.

folded.object: assalamakeng ri watakkalena seddi sedddi tau

spans.text: Sininna rupa tau nappunnai hak tuo ri linoe, paneddingi riasengnge attennangeng na assalamakeng ri watakkalena seddi sedddi tau.

folded.object: kewajibang kewajibanna na rilaleng sininna tuntutanna pidana ye ripettuangngi

folded.subject: sanreseng hukung

spans.text: Sininna rupa tau nappunai hak riasengnge sanreseng hukung na de' gaga ripasilaingeng.

folded.id: seddi tau|arega|nappunnangi sibawa tau laingnge
folded.subject: seddi tau

spans.text: Sininna rupa tauwe nappunai hak riasengnge assugireng na warangparang, mo nappunnangi seddi tau arega nappunnangi sibawa tau laingnge.

spans.text: Riasengnge seddi tettongeng wassele pura naolae sininna Bangsa na Negarae ye situjue napurennuangnge sininna rupa tau ri lalenna masyaraka'e.

folded.id: tau maegae|arega|cuale alena

spans.text: Ri olona tau maegae arega cuale alena.

folded.id: undang dasar|na|hukungnge
folded.subject: Undang Dasar

spans.text: Sininna rupa tau napunnai hak riasengnge makkuraga addecengeng ri pengadilan nasional'e molaie jamang jamang sala ye de e nasituju hak hak marilaleng ye napuwere Undang Undang Dasar na hukungnge.

folded.id: undang nasionale|arega|internasionale

spans.text: Degaga seddi rupa tau wedding ripassa mappigau assalang hukung nasaba pangkaukang ye dee'panatama mencaji assalang hukung menuru Undang Undang Nasionale arega internasionale, narekko ye pangkaukangnge ri pigau .
